item.title: [75] TorchTPU is now open source: Run native PyTorch on TPUs
item.description: Today at PyTorch Conference 2026, we announced a range of new products and integrations designed to help you run PyTorch effectively on Google Cloud or in your own infrastructure. Notably, TorchTPU, our native PyTorch stack for Google TPUs, is now available as open source on GitHub. With TorchTPU, TPUs join GPUs and CPUs as a native option for PyTorch.
